description: Get canonical listing lifecycle events across CEXs and Perp DEXs, including source URLs, confidence, source-observation freshness (for official overlays, the newest listing the venue reports), partial status, and per-provider coverage. Pass the opaque cursor through unchanged.

cursor.description: Opaque two-stream cursor returned by the previous page. Pass it through unchanged.

event_type.description: Filter by listing lifecycle event type.

exchange.description: Filter to a single exchange or perp DEX.

from.description: ISO date or datetime lower bound.

to.description: ISO date or datetime upper bound.

name: get_listing_events

effective_at.description: When the event takes effect. An `exchange_kline` row at exactly 00:00:00Z is a UTC date, not a time: the venue's first daily candle dates it.

first_seen_at.description: When the event was first seen. Database rows: the ingest's first sighting. Announcement rows: the announcement time. Official live-overlay rows (`source_kind: official_api`): the venue's listing time, or the snapshot fetch time for a scheduled pre-launch; never in the future.

last_observed_at.description: Newest timestamp on this provider's rows (write, announce, first-seen, first-trade or effective time), capped at the response time; null when it returned no rows. Database: the newest row write or observation. Official overlay: the newest listing time the venue reports, not our fetch time (a scheduled pre-launch row's first_seen_at is the fetch time).

generated_at.description: Time the API assembled this response. This is not a source freshness timestamp.

last_updated_at.description: Freshest observation timestamp present in the database or official overlay rows.

partial.description: True exactly when partial_reasons is non-empty.

partial_reasons.description: One sentence per coverage gap: a provider whose request failed, a live exchange instrument feed whose newest listing is more than 60 days old, the hourly spot-listings ingest when the query covers its venues and its last completed run is more than 2 hours old, the canonical events table being unavailable (rows then come from the compatibility table), or a requested exchange, venue_type or market_type that no enabled connector covers. Empty when coverage is whole.

meta.description: Which route answered, what the API said about the data's freshness, and whether the client cut the answer to fit the agent's context window.

route.description: Always `v1`: every call reads the keyed /v1 route.

truncated.description: True when the answer is cut short: by the API's row budget, or by the client (`truncated_fields`).

truncated_fields.description: The arrays and strings the client cut, by JSON path in `data`: `total` items received, `showing` kept, `kept: latest` when an oldest-first series kept its newest items.

warnings.description: What the API or the client could not do, in words. State them with the answer.

pagination.description: Present when the answer is one page: pass `cursor` back to read the next one.

title: Canonical listing events
